text:
noah_t: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp is flaking on rerank+embeddings parity across SDKs. Node v0.9.x and Go v0.6 behave differently when the batch helper triggers a retry: sometimes we get swapped order + an empty vector for the 2nd item. Python seems stable.

anya_docs: Ugh, can you paste the minimal request/response? Also are you using the batcher helper provided by the sampleapp or custom code?

noah_t: Using sampleapp helper (batcher.ts). Minimal POST:
```json
POST /v1/rerank/batch
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <token>

{
  "model": "rerank-lite-1",
  "queries": ["find best match"],
  "candidates": [["a","b"], ["c","d"]]
}
```
Node SDK response (flaky run):
```json
{
  "results": [
    { "score": 0.92, "vector": [0.002, -0.1, ...] },
    { "score": 0.21, "vector": [] }
  ]
}
```
Expected: both vectors non-empty and order should match candidates.

tom_infra: This matches a pattern we saw: when the auth token refresh triggers while the batch is in-flight, the retry path sometimes replays only a fragment of the batch. Server merges partial fragments but the client zipper assumes index alignment by position. If a fragment arrives late it can be merged at the wrong slot -> swapped order or empty slot.

anya_docs: Repro steps for me? I can try to reproduce locally if you share the script to force token refresh during a request.

noah_t: I added a small script that forces access_token expiry (set token expiry to now) and then fires a burst of batched rerank requests. Repro rate ~30% on my laptop.

tom_infra: Short-term mitigations: 1) attach stable ids to each candidate and each query in the payload and reassemble response by id, not by array index; 2) SDKs should validate response vector shapes and retry the entire batch if any vector is missing/empty (fail-safe); 3) add a server-side guard that rejects partial fragment merges if missing ids are detected.

noah_t: I patched the node batcher to annotate each candidate with `_id: <nanoid()>` and changed the zipper to map by `_id`. Quick smoke: no more empty vectors in 2000 runs.

anya_docs: Great — I'll add a short onboarding note: "if you see empty vectors or incorrect ordering in batched rerank responses, enable BATCHER_SAFE_BY_ID and upgrade SDKs". Also filing DOCS-510 to cover the cause and UX guidance.

core-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sdk-node/pulls/1295 — "batcher: stable ids + id-based reassembly for rerank/embeddings"; https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sdk-go/pulls/367 — equivalent patch. CI queued.

tom_infra: Longer term we should harden auth client: single-flight refresh (block callers while refresh completes) and make retry wrapper replay whole batches, not fragments. I'll open infra ticket INFRA-887.

noah_t: Thanks. Also noticed a small doc mismatch: server returns field name `vector` for rerank but `embedding` for embeddings endpoint. We should standardize or document both exact field names per endpoint — confusion is driving SDK parity bugs.

anya_docs: Good catch — I'll add a note in the API reference and propose an API consistency RFC. For now docs will show both fields with examples.

noah_t: Leaving this thread. Will follow PR and ping if any flakiness remains after CI run. :pray:
